title: RollcallResource.render_post returns 2.01 without Location-Path
description: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:452 (pre-existing, noted during zbn8 review): POST /rollcall returns 2.01 Created without Location-Path/Query, the same RFC 7252 §5.8.1 conformance point that motivated the /sos 2.01->2.04 fix. Unlike /sos, a rollcall POST does create a new rollcall entry, so 2.01 is defensible IF a Location-Path option is added (e.g. /rollcall/<id>); otherwise switch to 2.04. Decide and align the C checkin_resource.h documentation which documents 'POST /rollcall (18.6.2) -> 2.01 Created'.
